    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies RPC argument handling and deprecation checks in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp for non-wallet RPCs such as createrawtransaction and createpsbt.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Follows standard RPC deprecation discipline for obsolete BIP 125 parameters across raw transaction RPCs. Deprecating arguments without immediately removing them ensures compatibility for external callers, though addressing redundant parameter clutter is reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor edit to src/util/rbf.h (+5/-0) is purely ancillary to the RPC deprecation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change touches rbf.h only to support the deprecation logic rather than improving shared utilities infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Wallet label and modifications to wallet RPC handlers in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp and src/wallet/spend.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deprecates the redundant `replaceable` argument in wallet creation and fee-bumping RPCs following network-wide full-RBF adoption. This cleans up wallet interfaces and prepares for complete removal in a future major release (#32661)."
